---

## 2. Mods as a growth engine

### 2.1 What people actually rent modded servers for (evidence)
- **Modrinth's most-downloaded modpacks** (live API, 2026-10-01; 18,631 modpacks in total): Fabulously Optimized 17.8M (client-only), Zombie Invade 100 Days 14.8M, **Cobblemon Official Modpack 11.0M**, **COBBLEVERSE 6.9M**, **Better MC [Fabric] 3.5M**, Vanilla Perfected 2.5M, Pixelmon Modpack 2.3M, **Prominence II 2.1M**. Several of these mark `server_side: required`, which means they are server-renting packs. **Cobblemon (Pokémon-style) is the standout server-demand signal**, and it is on Modrinth, which our engine already installs.
- **All The Mods 10** is described as the most popular kitchen-sink pack of 2026, at 13M+ downloads (snippet: supercraft, teramont). **ATM10 and RLCraft are CurseForge-first**, and CurseForge API terms forbid caching or a competing service [MS finding 2]. That is a legal gap for one-click.
- **Valheim on Thunderstore** (live, 2026-10-01; 6,838 packages; top by downloads): BepInExPack 7.2M, Jotunn 4.7M, PlantEverything 2.7M, EpicLoot 2.3M, Server_devcommands 1.2M, Warfare / Monstrum / Armory (Therzie) about 0.8 to 1.5M each. Our own tickets asked for ValheimPlus, BetterNetworking, MaxPlayerCount and devcommands [KB].
- **Rust**: 1,419 uMod plugins in an open manifest [MS]. Plugins are what Rust server owners shop for. Our installer works, but the platform does not install Oxide/Carbon [MC].
- **Our own mods pages drive traffic**: 20 of the top 30 marketing paths are `/mods/games/*` [GD]. The catalogue is already an SEO asset.

### 2.2 What competitors offer (one-click modpacks)
| Host | Modpack offer | Source |
|---|---|---|
| BisectHosting | "2,300+ modpacks on one-click installs", auto-installs qualifying CurseForge packs, 21 locations | bisecthosting.com/curseforge (snippet); [FE] |
| PebbleHost | "12,000+ modpacks" one-click | [FE] (2026-09-27) |
| Aternos (free) | Modpacks from CurseForge, Modrinth, ATLauncher and FTB, one at a time, free mods only; Hytale mods via CurseForge | [support.aternos.org](https://support.aternos.org/hc/en-us/articles/4409967265425-Install-modpacks-Minecraft-Java-Edition) (snippet) |
| Modrinth Servers | Native one-click Modrinth packs, $3/GB (4 GB $12), live in about 2 min, US-only at beta, run with Pyro; "automatic creator commissions" planned | [modrinth.com/news](https://modrinth.com/news/article/modrinth-servers-beta/) (2024-11-03, fetched) |
| GPORTAL | "250+ modpacks"; Valheim has ValheimPlus integration and 1-click mods | [FE]; [g-portal Valheim](https://www.g-portal.com/en/gameserver/valheim-server-hosting) (fetched 2026-10-01) |
| **Nxeon** | `.mrpack` install (exact loader and version, max 600 files / 400 MB) inside the Mods tab. **Not offered in the deploy wizard** (DeployView has no modpack step, grep 2026-10-01) | [MC] |

**Conclusion.** One-click modpacks are table stakes, not a differentiator. What we can do that others mostly don't:
(a) **modpack chosen at first deploy, server sized to it automatically**;
(b) **version-pinned jars plus a mirror**, so restarts don't depend on upstream outages;
(c) **auto-update only to versions compatible with every installed mod, with rollback**;
(d) **a "join kit" for friends** (section 2.4).

### 2.3 "Nxeon Verified": is it valued, and what would make it credible?
- What comparable "verified" programmes are: CurseForge reviews each Hytale submission (snippet [MS §4]). Modrinth moderates projects. Bisect's "official partner" is a **commercial** label (creator gets commission), not a quality label ([CurseForge Server Affiliation FAQ](https://support.curseforge.com/support/solutions/articles/9000240602-curseforge-server-affiliation-program-faq), 2024-09-04). **I found no evidence that players value a host-issued badge as such. Their value is UNVERIFIED** (risky assumption #3).
- What players clearly *do* suffer from is "installed a mod, server broke or friends can't join". Tickets 2, 11 and 12 [KB] cover deprecated ValheimPlus after 1.0, a mod loader reset by a Steam update, and a client-mod version mismatch.
- **To be credible, the badge must be a reproducible test, not a claim**: "booted on Nxeon's image for game version X with loader Y on date Z; server reached 'ready'; mod's own load line found in log; survived one restart", with the date and the version shown in the popup, and **removed automatically** when the game updates until it is retested. Never imply a security review. Publish the criteria on one public page.

### 2.4 Viral loop: share-a-server / join kit (recommended)
- Precedent: r2modman / Thunderstore lets a host "Export profile as code" so friends import the same mod list. The codes are temporary ([Steam guide](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3167912240), snippet).
- Build: every server gets a `/join/<code>` page with:
  - the address, and a password shown only to invited people;
  - for client-mod games (Valheim BepInEx, modded MC), the **exact client mod list** as a Modrinth `.mrpack` / r2modman-compatible list, with step-by-step install instructions;
  - console-join instructions where relevant (PS5/Xbox search by name; ticket 13 [KB]);
  - a "Host your own on Nxeon" CTA that carries a referral attribution.
- This turns every customer's friends (Valheim: up to 10 per world, per the Valheim 1.0 snippet) into qualified visitors. It also stops the most frequent mod ticket at the source.

### 2.5 Mod-author partnerships and revenue share
- Benchmark: the CurseForge x BisectHosting affiliation gives the **author 65%, Bisect 30%, CurseForge 5% of first-month purchases**, with a 25% buyer discount and no exclusivity (CurseForge FAQ, 2024-09-04; [Bisect blog](https://www.bisecthosting.com/blog/bisect-hosting-curseforge-partnership-server-discount-creator-kickback), 2024-07-08). Bisect also ships an in-game "Server Integration" mod that puts the partner link in the multiplayer menu ([Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/bisect-mod)).
- Nxeon already runs a Creator Partner Program (50% first month, 10% recurring, real click tracking; memory note 2026-09-26). **Offer it to modpack authors** as "official server" pages, e.g. `/modpacks/<pack>`: a pinned server pack, a pre-sized plan and the author's code. That is competitive with Bisect's 65% of the first month only, because ours adds recurring. Start with Modrinth-hosted packs we can legally install (Cobblemon-based packs, Better MC, Prominence II), and only after asking `support@modrinth.com` for written OK on bulk mirroring [MS finding 3].
- **Risk**: Modrinth runs its own hosting, so a partnership there may be competitive. CurseForge's affiliation is "exclusively BisectHosting" (FAQ). Never imply CurseForge endorsement.

### 2.6 Modpack-of-the-week landing pages
These are cheap to generate from the catalogue. They target "<pack> server hosting" queries, which are **UNVERIFIED** search volume, but our /mods pages already rank as entry points [GD]. Each page needs a real "Deploy with this pack" button. Without it, the pages are just SEO filler.

---

## 3. Pricing and packaging

### 3.1 Where we sit (list = renewal price; intro = first term)
| Game, about 4 GB | Nxeon list / intro [PL] | Competitor | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Minecraft 4 GB | $12.94 / $8.99 | Apex 4 GB $14.99 (first month $8.99); Shockbyte 2 GB $5.59 ($2.80/GB); Modrinth Servers 4 GB $12; PebbleHost and Sparked budget $1/GB | [FE] 2026-09-27; Modrinth news 2024-11-03 |
| Valheim 4 GB / 10 | $14.38 / $9.99 | Shockbyte 4 GB "7 players" $12.99, 6 GB+ $16.99, annual 25% off, 72h refund; GPORTAL 10 slots $15.59/30 days, **3-day rental $6.24** | [shockbyte](https://shockbyte.com/games/valheim-server-hosting), [g-portal](https://www.g-portal.com/en/gameserver/valheim-server-hosting), fetched 2026-10-01 |
| CS2 | 2 GB $17.26 / $11.99 | DatHost 14 slots €13.86/mo, €11.09/mo yearly, 14-day money-back | dathost.com, fetched 2026-10-01 |

Our intro price is competitive. **Our renewal price is about 1.44x intro** on every family (from [PL]) and sits at or above the mid-market on Valheim and CS2. Whether customers churn at renewal is **UNVERIFIED**: the snapshot has 43 RUNNING servers and no expired ones yet [GD], so renewal behaviour is not yet observable.

### 3.2 Free tier: design and the bridge to paid
- **Aternos**: free and ad-funded; queues at busy times; stops empty servers ([support.aternos.org](https://support.aternos.org/hc/en-us/articles/360026950812-Queue), snippet).
- **Minehut**: free 1 GB, 10 players, sleeps when empty, 10 GB storage, up to 5 free servers per account (limit from 2026-08-03), daily 4-hour limit removed 2026-07-06. Paid plans in credits: Standard 2 GB 600 credits, Pro 6 GB 1,800, Ultimate 14 GB 6,000 and the only "online 24/7" tier. Paid plans add sub-users (1/3/6) ([minehut.com/server-plans](https://www.minehut.com/server-plans) fetched 2026-10-01; limit dates are snippets).
- **exaroton**: pay-per-use at 1 credit (€0.01) per GB per hour, auto-stop after 10 min empty, 5 free credits ([support.exaroton.com](https://support.exaroton.com/hc/en-us/articles/360019687657-Pricing), snippet).
- **Nxeon free MC**: wakes on connect with no queue (mc-router; median wake 23-33 s; plugin servers boot 15-77 s). Memory floors are 1.5 GB vanilla / 2.5 GB plugins (`lib/freemc-limits.ts`, 2026-10-01). That file already calls slow wakes "honest upsell signals". Four global OOM kills were traced to host ballooning (same file).
- **Upgrade triggers to build**, each one honest and measurable:
  - (1) wake time over 30 s, or "Can't keep up" lag, leads to "Always-on, no wake delay";
  - (2) installing a modpack whose requirement is above the free floor leads to "this pack needs 6 GB, deploy it now";
  - (3) more than N concurrent players;
  - (4) wanting backups beyond what free keeps;
  - (5) wanting a dedicated IP.
- **The one-click upgrade must carry the world, settings and subdomain over**, at the intro price, in Singapore by default.

### 3.3 Other packaging moves
- **Money-back guarantee, not a trial**: we already have a 72-hour money-back (`lib/refund-policy.ts`, owner decision 2026-09-27), the same as Shockbyte and Bisect. **Show it inside the deploy wizard at the pay step** (the wizard has no money-back mention: grep of DeployView, 2026-10-01). A free paid-server trial is the abuse magnet; the free MC tier already plays the trial role.
- **Short rentals ("weekend pass")**: GPORTAL sells a 3-day Valheim server for $6.24. That suits SEA friend groups and price-sensitive visitors. It is an experiment, not a default.
- **Annual and quarterly**: ours is 20% annual (admin-configurable), with 30% and 40% for 2 and 3 years [FE]. Shockbyte Valheim gives 10% quarterly and 25% annual; DatHost 10% quarterly and 20% yearly. Adding a **quarterly 10%** is cheap and matches the field.
- **SEA payment methods**: checkout is card (Stripe `payment_method_types: ["card"]`), PayPal and Coinbase crypto (repo grep, 2026-10-01). Stripe Singapore supports **PayNow and GrabPay**, but not GCash or QRIS natively ([stripe.com/en-sg](https://stripe.com/en-sg/payments/payment-methods), snippet). PH, ID and VN are 3 of our top 6 visitor countries [GD]. A local wallet PSP for GCash/QRIS (e.g. Xendit/PayMongo: **fees and coverage UNVERIFIED**) is the bigger unlock. Card-less buyers today have no path except PayPal. Wallet top-up (which already exists: ticket 7 used it) is the natural rail.
- **Regional (PPP) pricing**: Steam's own SEA pricing is about 35-45% of USD (snippet: regionalpricecalculator). This is an experiment only. It risks arbitrage and pricing-message confusion. If tested, tie it to *billing country + Singapore region* on 2-3 games, and measure.
- **Student discount**: not recommended now (verification cost, no evidence of demand). **Creator discount** already exists through the partner programme.
- **Bundles** (game + domain + VPS): we are the only host researched with one account across VPS, game, web, domain and email [FE]. But paid VPS/web customers are small. Test **"game server + free .play subdomain + Discord bot hosting"** before domain bundles.
- **Referral**: 0 of 51 customers are attributed [GD]. A player-to-player "give credit, get credit" tied to the join-kit link (section 2.4) is the cheapest referral engine. The amount is an owner decision.

---

## 4. Features that win customers

Ranked by how much each wins customers. Status is from the repo, memory notes, [FE] and [MC]. This is only what we can truthfully deliver.

| # | Differentiator | Status | Competitor gap (evidence) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Singapore-first latency, honest region choice per customer** | HAVE | Ticket 1 [KB]: a PH customer had 276 ms on a Germany server, fixed by moving to Singapore. GGServers charges **2x for premium locations incl. Singapore** [FE] |
| 2 | **Modpack/mod install with version + loader match, deps, checksums, rollback** | HAVE (MC, Valheim, Rust plugins, CS2, Factorio) | Most hosts do one-click; few publish dependency/checksum handling ([MC] lists 7 bugs we already fixed) |
| 3 | **Pinned server jars + mirror** (restarts never depend on upstream outages) | HAVE | The PaperMC outage crash-looped a new server (memory note, 2026-10-01). No competitor claim found (UNVERIFIED that they lack it) |
| 4 | **Join kit / share-a-server profile** | BUILD (player-profile export is in progress) | r2modman has codes; no host-integrated equivalent found (UNVERIFIED) |
| 5 | **Cross-node/region transfer, self-serve** | IN PROGRESS | Done by hand twice in [KB] (3-6 h, then 30-45 min). Self-serve turns a ticket into a feature |
| 6 | **Credit-backed 99.9% SLA** | HAVE | None of 11 competitors researched publish credit terms [FE] |
| 7 | **Free MC with no queue** | HAVE | Aternos queues |
| 8 | **Auto game updates + post-update mod health check** | PARTIAL | Ticket 11: mods "disappeared" after a Steam update until restart. Auto-restart plus verify would have prevented it |
| 9 | **Real game-state truth / status** | HAVE | Ticket 12 "server down, no notice". Pair status with customer notifications |
| 10 | Minecraft skin creator, tools | HAVE | Top-of-funnel only, no evidence it converts (UNVERIFIED) |

**Table-stakes gaps that block signups** (fix before adding games):
1. **Local payment methods** (section 3.3).
2. **Deploy-wizard trust bits**: money-back shown at pay; "Sized for ~N players" (done); Valheim server password field at checkout (tickets 7 and 8 [KB]: a customer could not pay, and it was deployed by hand).
3. **Self-serve cancel/refund**: a live chat [KB] says "it not have cancel or delete button", then 404, then "i want to refund now". The memory note "game renew/cancel unreachable" is still listed as unfixed.
4. **Provisioning failure honesty**: chat [KB], "take 30 minute to provision and it fail".
5. **World import** for Valheim (.db/.fwl), MC and Terraria (ticket 15 and long chat 1 [KB]). Folder upload and archive extract are being built. Add a guided "Import my world" step.
6. **Player log / who joined** (ticket 10 [KB]).
7. **Sub-users with real per-server permissions**: missing [FE]. Minehut's paid plans include 1-6 sub-users. Friend groups share admin.
8. **Game switching**: missing. DatHost advertises "unlimited game swapping across 20+ titles" (fetched 2026-10-01).
9. **Discord**: we have Discord support/status commands (`lib/discord-*`). A customer-facing "start/stop/status from your Discord" bot is UNVERIFIED as a competitor norm, so it is medium priority.
10. **Mobile panel / PWA**: low priority. Only 558 of 22,803 unique visitors were mobile [GD], though see the bot caveat in section 0.

DDoS: only say "DDoS-protected network". Publish no Gbps figure, because none is ours to publish [FE].

---

## 5. Activation and retention moves

**First 5 minutes, per flagship game:**
- **Minecraft**:
  - land, pick "Vanilla / Paper / a modpack"; choose from the top 6 server-side Modrinth packs (Cobblemon, COBBLEVERSE, Better MC, Prominence II, Vanilla Perfected...);
  - plan auto-sized to the pack; region defaults from geo;
  - pay, then the address appears; the join-kit page offers "send to friends";
  - free-tier visitors get a free server in one click, with the upgrade path shown in the panel.
- **Valheim**:
  - default to BepInEx. Today 2 of 4 live servers are vanilla, so mods can't load without a switch [MC];
  - crossplay on by default (ticket 6: the setting wasn't applied, now fixed);
  - password field visible at checkout;
  - a world-import step;
  - presets "Vanilla+ QoL" (PlantEverything, Quick Stack, devcommands) and "Big group" (MaxPlayerCount + BetterNetworking), based on what customers asked for in tickets 2, 4 and 12;
  - a client-mod warning before installing anything client-required.
- **Palworld / Valheim console players**: an auto-generated "how PS5/Xbox friends join" card (ticket 13: consoles can only join by searching the server name).
- **Rust**: install Oxide in one click when "oxide" is picked; preset plugin bundles (only non-exclusive licences, metadata from uMod [MS]).

**Lifecycle emails** (email tracking exists; memory note 2026-08-24):
- Signed up, no deploy after 1 h and 24 h: a game-specific "deploy in 60 s" email with the landing game pre-selected. This targets the 95% gap.
- Deployed, no player joined in 24 h: a connection-help email covering ports and console join.
- Before renewal: show the renewal price clearly, offer annual, and flag grandfathered pricing where it applies.
- Game-update day (Valheim 1.0, Enshrouded 1.0, a MC drop): "your server is updated; these mods are compatible; these are paused".

**Community**: the free public Valheim directory and the free-MC server directory are retention and SEO surfaces. Each listing should link to that server's join kit.

---

## 6. What to remove or simplify

1. **Retire Nightingale for new orders** (56 CCU).
2. **Demote 7 sub-1,000-CCU games** out of the primary picker and carousel; they stay orderable.
3. **Keep Schedule I unorderable** and check that no landing page sells it. Keep Plutonium unlisted.
4. **Do not launch managed FiveM.** The `/fivem-server-hosting` page exists, so make sure its copy sells only a VPS you run yourself, with no implied authorisation.
5. **Draft site routes `app/newwebsitev1` to `v8`** sit in the production app tree. If they can be reached publicly they dilute crawl budget and confuse visitors. I did not check whether they are reachable (no production access). Remove or noindex them.
6. **Narrow the homepage and nav to game servers**, with VPS/web as secondary. /game-servers is the #1 path and most paid servers are games [GD]. Side products (n8n/nextcloud/vibe-coding pages, ventures) should stay out of the main nav. The owner decides which to keep.
7. **`/free-vps`** is the #3 landing path (256) [GD], but its conversion is unknown. Measure free-VPS signup to paid before investing. Free compute is an abuse target (UNVERIFIED for us specifically).
8. **One plan-ladder story.** The 4-tier ladder is staging-only and unsigned-off [PL]. Choose it *or* the current 2-3 tiers, so the wizard stays simple. The evidence on choice overload versus defaults is in the memory note "Checkout conversion research": defaults matter more than the number of pages.

---

## 7. Top 10 actions

1. Rebuild first-deploy activation: game pre-selected from the landing page, geo-default region, money-back at the pay step, 1 h / 24 h no-deploy emails (prd-001, -002, -030).
2. Put a modpack step in the deploy wizard for Minecraft (top server-side Modrinth packs, auto-sized) (prd-010).
3. Ship the Valheim 1.0 flagship package: BepInEx default, presets, world import, password and crossplay fixes, client-mod warning (prd-003, -013, -032).
4. Build the join-kit / share-a-server link with referral attribution, which is the viral loop (prd-012).
5. Add local SEA payment methods: PayNow/GrabPay through Stripe now, then GCash/QRIS through a local PSP (prd-021).
6. One-click Oxide/Carbon for Rust plus the uMod manifest (prd-006).
7. Free-MC to paid bridge: one-click upgrade that keeps the world, with honest triggers (prd-018).
8. Apply for Hytale GSP registration, then launch BYO-auth Hytale (prd-024).
9. Launch-window pages and capacity for Enshrouded 1.0 (2026-10-15) and ASA Dragontopia (2026-12-09) (prd-008, -009).
10. Fix self-serve cancel/refund and provisioning-failure honesty, which are trust blockers (prd-031).

## 8. The 5 riskiest assumptions
1. **The traffic since 2026-09-25 is real human demand.** It is 97.5% desktop and "(direct)" from mobile-first countries. If it is bots, the true signup rate and the case for SEA PPP both change.
2. **Activation is the bottleneck, not product-market fit.** 5% signup-to-server could also mean the signups are low-intent (promo/riddle hunters). Check the signup source mix before building.
3. **"Nxeon Verified" and modpack-partner pages will move purchases.** I found no evidence of badge value. Competitors win modpack traffic through *creator links*, not badges.
4. **Hytale will grant us GSP status, or BYO-auth is allowed for paid hosting.** The EULA is a personal, non-commercial licence [NG], and the support pages were unreadable (403).
5. **Lower renewal prices or PPP will raise revenue rather than just cut margin.** We have no renewal or churn data yet (no server has reached renewal in the snapshot), and our true cost per GB is undocumented.

## 9. What I could not verify
- Hytale player numbers, GSP terms and the per-licence server cap (support.hytale.com returned 403; the figures are snippets).
- FiveM's *current* enforcement against unauthorised hosts (the ban evidence is from 2018; today's partner list is snippets).
- Google Trends, Reddit sizes and "<game> server hosting" search volumes for every game.
- Farming Simulator 25, Bannerlord and SCUM hosting terms; FS25 Linux feasibility.
- Our real cost per GB per node (so margin is a proxy). Per-game support load outside Valheim.
- Whether competitors lack jar pinning, join kits, cross-region transfer or Discord bots (absence not proven).
- Fees and coverage of GCash/QRIS PSPs. Stripe SG's PayNow/GrabPay is a snippet.
- Whether `app/newwebsitev*` routes are publicly reachable. Free-MC signup counts and free-to-paid conversion (not in the snapshot).
- Minehut free-tier date changes (fetched page confirmed the plans; the dates are snippets because the support article returned 403).

## 0. The finding that matters most: activation, not traffic or catalogue

| ...of which ever had a server / a paid server | 30 / 29 (about 4.8%) |

What this means:
1. **About 95% of signups never deploy anything.** Adding more games will not fix that. The product moves with the most leverage are about the first-deploy experience: defaults, a modpack on first deploy, the free-to-paid bridge, and local payment methods.
2. **The traffic jump from 2026-09-25 (about 50 to about 4,000 unique IPs a day) is almost all "(direct)", 97.5% desktop, and comes from countries that are normally mobile-heavy.** It may be bot traffic or a paid campaign. Treat visits since 09-25 as **UNVERIFIED human demand** until checked. That is risky assumption #1.
3. **The paid mix today** (active servers by hostname prefix, [GD]) is web 7, minecraft 7, vps 3, valheim 2, rust 2, and singles of dst, corekeeper, terraria, cs2, palworld and projectzomboid, plus about 10 custom-named hostnames. The tickets show at least two of those are Valheim (terraheim, shizu) and two are Minecraft (bujangsmp, upnormal Bedrock). **Minecraft and Valheim are the business.**

## 2. Mods as a growth engine

### 2.1 What people actually rent modded servers for (evidence)
- **Modrinth's most-downloaded modpacks** (live API, 2026-10-01; 18,631 modpacks in total): Fabulously Optimized 17.8M (client-only), Zombie Invade 100 Days 14.8M, **Cobblemon Official Modpack 11.0M**, **COBBLEVERSE 6.9M**, **Better MC [Fabric] 3.5M**, Vanilla Perfected 2.5M, Pixelmon Modpack 2.3M, **Prominence II 2.1M**. Several of these mark `server_side: required`, which means they are server-renting packs. **Cobblemon (Pokémon-style) is the standout server-demand signal**, and it is on Modrinth, which our engine already installs.
- **All The Mods 10** is described as the most popular kitchen-sink pack of 2026, at 13M+ downloads (snippet: supercraft, teramont). **ATM10 and RLCraft are CurseForge-first**, and CurseForge API terms forbid caching or a competing service [MS finding 2]. That is a legal gap for one-click.
- **Valheim on Thunderstore** (live, 2026-10-01; 6,838 packages; top by downloads): BepInExPack 7.2M, Jotunn 4.7M, PlantEverything 2.7M, EpicLoot 2.3M, Server_devcommands 1.2M, Warfare / Monstrum / Armory (Therzie) about 0.8 to 1.5M each. Our own tickets asked for ValheimPlus, BetterNetworking, MaxPlayerCount and devcommands [KB].
- **Rust**: 1,419 uMod plugins in an open manifest [MS]. Plugins are what Rust server owners shop for. Our installer works, but the platform does not install Oxide/Carbon [MC].
- **Our own mods pages drive traffic**: 20 of the top 30 marketing paths are `/mods/games/*` [GD]. The catalogue is already an SEO asset.

(a) **modpack chosen at first deploy, server sized to it automatically**;
(b) **version-pinned jars plus a mirror**, so restarts don't depend on upstream outages;
(c) **auto-update only to versions compatible with every installed mod, with rollback**;

### 2.3 "Nxeon Verified": is it valued, and what would make it credible?
- What comparable "verified" programmes are: CurseForge reviews each Hytale submission (snippet [MS §4]). Modrinth moderates projects. Bisect's "official partner" is a **commercial** label (creator gets commission), not a quality label ([CurseForge Server Affiliation FAQ](https://support.curseforge.com/support/solutions/articles/9000240602-curseforge-server-affiliation-program-faq), 2024-09-04). **I found no evidence that players value a host-issued badge as such. Their value is UNVERIFIED** (risky assumption #3).
- What players clearly *do* suffer from is "installed a mod, server broke or friends can't join". Tickets 2, 11 and 12 [KB] cover deprecated ValheimPlus after 1.0, a mod loader reset by a Steam update, and a client-mod version mismatch.
- **To be credible, the badge must be a reproducible test, not a claim**: "booted on Nxeon's image for game version X with loader Y on date Z; server reached 'ready'; mod's own load line found in log; survived one restart", with the date and the version shown in the popup, and **removed automatically** when the game updates until it is retested. Never imply a security review. Publish the criteria on one public page.

### 2.4 Viral loop: share-a-server / join kit (recommended)
- Precedent: r2modman / Thunderstore lets a host "Export profile as code" so friends import the same mod list. The codes are temporary ([Steam guide](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3167912240), snippet).
- Build: every server gets a `/join/<code>` page with:
  - the address, and a password shown only to invited people;
  - for client-mod games (Valheim BepInEx, modded MC), the **exact client mod list** as a Modrinth `.mrpack` / r2modman-compatible list, with step-by-step install instructions;
  - console-join instructions where relevant (PS5/Xbox search by name; ticket 13 [KB]);
  - a "Host your own on Nxeon" CTA that carries a referral attribution.
- This turns every customer's friends (Valheim: up to 10 per world, per the Valheim 1.0 snippet) into qualified visitors. It also stops the most frequent mod ticket at the source.

### 2.5 Mod-author partnerships and revenue share
- Benchmark: the CurseForge x BisectHosting affiliation gives the **author 65%, Bisect 30%, CurseForge 5% of first-month purchases**, with a 25% buyer discount and no exclusivity (CurseForge FAQ, 2024-09-04; [Bisect blog](https://www.bisecthosting.com/blog/bisect-hosting-curseforge-partnership-server-discount-creator-kickback), 2024-07-08). Bisect also ships an in-game "Server Integration" mod that puts the partner link in the multiplayer menu ([Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/bisect-mod)).
- Nxeon already runs a Creator Partner Program (50% first month, 10% recurring, real click tracking; memory note 2026-09-26). **Offer it to modpack authors** as "official server" pages, e.g. `/modpacks/<pack>`: a pinned server pack, a pre-sized plan and the author's code. That is competitive with Bisect's 65% of the first month only, because ours adds recurring. Start with Modrinth-hosted packs we can legally install (Cobblemon-based packs, Better MC, Prominence II), and only after asking `support@modrinth.com` for written OK on bulk mirroring [MS finding 3].
- **Risk**: Modrinth runs its own hosting, so a partnership there may be competitive. CurseForge's affiliation is "exclusively BisectHosting" (FAQ). Never imply CurseForge endorsement.

### 2.6 Modpack-of-the-week landing pages
These are cheap to generate from the catalogue. They target "<pack> server hosting" queries, which are **UNVERIFIED** search volume, but our /mods pages already rank as entry points [GD]. Each page needs a real "Deploy with this pack" button. Without it, the pages are just SEO filler.

### 3.2 Free tier: design and the bridge to paid

- **Minehut**: free 1 GB, 10 players, sleeps when empty, 10 GB storage, up to 5 free servers per account (limit from 2026-08-03), daily 4-hour limit removed 2026-07-06. Paid plans in credits: Standard 2 GB 600 credits, Pro 6 GB 1,800, Ultimate 14 GB 6,000 and the only "online 24/7" tier. Paid plans add sub-users (1/3/6) ([minehut.com/server-plans](https://www.minehut.com/server-plans) fetched 2026-10-01; limit dates are snippets).
- **exaroton**: pay-per-use at 1 credit (€0.01) per GB per hour, auto-stop after 10 min empty, 5 free credits ([support.exaroton.com](https://support.exaroton.com/hc/en-us/articles/360019687657-Pricing), snippet).
- **Nxeon free MC**: wakes on connect with no queue (mc-router; median wake 23-33 s; plugin servers boot 15-77 s). Memory floors are 1.5 GB vanilla / 2.5 GB plugins (`lib/freemc-limits.ts`, 2026-10-01). That file already calls slow wakes "honest upsell signals". Four global OOM kills were traced to host ballooning (same file).
- **Upgrade triggers to build**, each one honest and measurable:
  - (1) wake time over 30 s, or "Can't keep up" lag, leads to "Always-on, no wake delay";
  - (2) installing a modpack whose requirement is above the free floor leads to "this pack needs 6 GB, deploy it now";
  - (3) more than N concurrent players;
  - (4) wanting backups beyond what free keeps;
  - (5) wanting a dedicated IP.
- **The one-click upgrade must carry the world, settings and subdomain over**, at the intro price, in Singapore by default.

### 3.3 Other packaging moves
- **Money-back guarantee, not a trial**: we already have a 72-hour money-back (`lib/refund-policy.ts`, owner decision 2026-09-27), the same as Shockbyte and Bisect. **Show it inside the deploy wizard at the pay step** (the wizard has no money-back mention: grep of DeployView, 2026-10-01). A free paid-server trial is the abuse magnet; the free MC tier already plays the trial role.
- **Short rentals ("weekend pass")**: GPORTAL sells a 3-day Valheim server for $6.24. That suits SEA friend groups and price-sensitive visitors. It is an experiment, not a default.
- **Annual and quarterly**: ours is 20% annual (admin-configurable), with 30% and 40% for 2 and 3 years [FE]. Shockbyte Valheim gives 10% quarterly and 25% annual; DatHost 10% quarterly and 20% yearly. Adding a **quarterly 10%** is cheap and matches the field.
- **SEA payment methods**: checkout is card (Stripe `payment_method_types: ["card"]`), PayPal and Coinbase crypto (repo grep, 2026-10-01). Stripe Singapore supports **PayNow and GrabPay**, but not GCash or QRIS natively ([stripe.com/en-sg](https://stripe.com/en-sg/payments/payment-methods), snippet). PH, ID and VN are 3 of our top 6 visitor countries [GD]. A local wallet PSP for GCash/QRIS (e.g. Xendit/PayMongo: **fees and coverage UNVERIFIED**) is the bigger unlock. Card-less buyers today have no path except PayPal. Wallet top-up (which already exists: ticket 7 used it) is the natural rail.
- **Regional (PPP) pricing**: Steam's own SEA pricing is about 35-45% of USD (snippet: regionalpricecalculator). This is an experiment only. It risks arbitrage and pricing-message confusion. If tested, tie it to *billing country + Singapore region* on 2-3 games, and measure.
- **Student discount**: not recommended now (verification cost, no evidence of demand). **Creator discount** already exists through the partner programme.
- **Bundles** (game + domain + VPS): we are the only host researched with one account across VPS, game, web, domain and email [FE]. But paid VPS/web customers are small. Test **"game server + free .play subdomain + Discord bot hosting"** before domain bundles.
- **Referral**: 0 of 51 customers are attributed [GD]. A player-to-player "give credit, get credit" tied to the join-kit link (section 2.4) is the cheapest referral engine. The amount is an owner decision.

2. **Deploy-wizard trust bits**: money-back shown at pay; "Sized for ~N players" (done); Valheim server password field at checkout (tickets 7 and 8 [KB]: a customer could not pay, and it was deployed by hand).
3. **Self-serve cancel/refund**: a live chat [KB] says "it not have cancel or delete button", then 404, then "i want to refund now". The memory note "game renew/cancel unreachable" is still listed as unfixed.
4. **Provisioning failure honesty**: chat [KB], "take 30 minute to provision and it fail".
5. **World import** for Valheim (.db/.fwl), MC and Terraria (ticket 15 and long chat 1 [KB]). Folder upload and archive extract are being built. Add a guided "Import my world" step.
6. **Player log / who joined** (ticket 10 [KB]).
7. **Sub-users with real per-server permissions**: missing [FE]. Minehut's paid plans include 1-6 sub-users. Friend groups share admin.
8. **Game switching**: missing. DatHost advertises "unlimited game swapping across 20+ titles" (fetched 2026-10-01).
9. **Discord**: we have Discord support/status commands (`lib/discord-*`). A customer-facing "start/stop/status from your Discord" bot is UNVERIFIED as a competitor norm, so it is medium priority.
10. **Mobile panel / PWA**: low priority. Only 558 of 22,803 unique visitors were mobile [GD], though see the bot caveat in section 0.

DDoS: only say "DDoS-protected network". Publish no Gbps figure, because none is ours to publish [FE].

---

## 5. Activation and retention moves

**First 5 minutes, per flagship game:**
- **Minecraft**:
  - land, pick "Vanilla / Paper / a modpack"; choose from the top 6 server-side Modrinth packs (Cobblemon, COBBLEVERSE, Better MC, Prominence II, Vanilla Perfected...);
  - plan auto-sized to the pack; region defaults from geo;
  - pay, then the address appears; the join-kit page offers "send to friends";
  - free-tier visitors get a free server in one click, with the upgrade path shown in the panel.
- **Valheim**:
  - default to BepInEx. Today 2 of 4 live servers are vanilla, so mods can't load without a switch [MC];
  - crossplay on by default (ticket 6: the setting wasn't applied, now fixed);
  - password field visible at checkout;
  - a world-import step;
  - presets "Vanilla+ QoL" (PlantEverything, Quick Stack, devcommands) and "Big group" (MaxPlayerCount + BetterNetworking), based on what customers asked for in tickets 2, 4 and 12;
  - a client-mod warning before installing anything client-required.
- **Palworld / Valheim console players**: an auto-generated "how PS5/Xbox friends join" card (ticket 13: consoles can only join by searching the server name).
- **Rust**: install Oxide in one click when "oxide" is picked; preset plugin bundles (only non-exclusive licences, metadata from uMod [MS]).

**Lifecycle emails** (email tracking exists; memory note 2026-08-24):
- Signed up, no deploy after 1 h and 24 h: a game-specific "deploy in 60 s" email with the landing game pre-selected. This targets the 95% gap.
- Deployed, no player joined in 24 h: a connection-help email covering ports and console join.
- Before renewal: show the renewal price clearly, offer annual, and flag grandfathered pricing where it applies.
- Game-update day (Valheim 1.0, Enshrouded 1.0, a MC drop): "your server is updated; these mods are compatible; these are paused".

**Community**: the free public Valheim directory and the free-MC server directory are retention and SEO surfaces. Each listing should link to that server's join kit.

---

## 6. What to remove or simplify

1. **Retire Nightingale for new orders** (56 CCU).
2. **Demote 7 sub-1,000-CCU games** out of the primary picker and carousel; they stay orderable.
3. **Keep Schedule I unorderable** and check that no landing page sells it. Keep Plutonium unlisted.
4. **Do not launch managed FiveM.** The `/fivem-server-hosting` page exists, so make sure its copy sells only a VPS you run yourself, with no implied authorisation.
5. **Draft site routes `app/newwebsitev1` to `v8`** sit in the production app tree. If they can be reached publicly they dilute crawl budget and confuse visitors. I did not check whether they are reachable (no production access). Remove or noindex them.
6. **Narrow the homepage and nav to game servers**, with VPS/web as secondary. /game-servers is the #1 path and most paid servers are games [GD]. Side products (n8n/nextcloud/vibe-coding pages, ventures) should stay out of the main nav. The owner decides which to keep.
7. **`/free-vps`** is the #3 landing path (256) [GD], but its conversion is unknown. Measure free-VPS signup to paid before investing. Free compute is an abuse target (UNVERIFIED for us specifically).
8. **One plan-ladder story.** The 4-tier ladder is staging-only and unsigned-off [PL]. Choose it *or* the current 2-3 tiers, so the wizard stays simple. The evidence on choice overload versus defaults is in the memory note "Checkout conversion research": defaults matter more than the number of pages.

---

## 7. Top 10 actions

1. Rebuild first-deploy activation: game pre-selected from the landing page, geo-default region, money-back at the pay step, 1 h / 24 h no-deploy emails (prd-001, -002, -030).
2. Put a modpack step in the deploy wizard for Minecraft (top server-side Modrinth packs, auto-sized) (prd-010).
3. Ship the Valheim 1.0 flagship package: BepInEx default, presets, world import, password and crossplay fixes, client-mod warning (prd-003, -013, -032).
4. Build the join-kit / share-a-server link with referral attribution, which is the viral loop (prd-012).
5. Add local SEA payment methods: PayNow/GrabPay through Stripe now, then GCash/QRIS through a local PSP (prd-021).
6. One-click Oxide/Carbon for Rust plus the uMod manifest (prd-006).
7. Free-MC to paid bridge: one-click upgrade that keeps the world, with honest triggers (prd-018).
8. Apply for Hytale GSP registration, then launch BYO-auth Hytale (prd-024).
9. Launch-window pages and capacity for Enshrouded 1.0 (2026-10-15) and ASA Dragontopia (2026-12-09) (prd-008, -009).
10. Fix self-serve cancel/refund and provisioning-failure honesty, which are trust blockers (prd-031).

## 8. The 5 riskiest assumptions
1. **The traffic since 2026-09-25 is real human demand.** It is 97.5% desktop and "(direct)" from mobile-first countries. If it is bots, the true signup rate and the case for SEA PPP both change.
2. **Activation is the bottleneck, not product-market fit.** 5% signup-to-server could also mean the signups are low-intent (promo/riddle hunters). Check the signup source mix before building.
3. **"Nxeon Verified" and modpack-partner pages will move purchases.** I found no evidence of badge value. Competitors win modpack traffic through *creator links*, not badges.
4. **Hytale will grant us GSP status, or BYO-auth is allowed for paid hosting.** The EULA is a personal, non-commercial licence [NG], and the support pages were unreadable (403).
5. **Lower renewal prices or PPP will raise revenue rather than just cut margin.** We have no renewal or churn data yet (no server has reached renewal in the snapshot), and our true cost per GB is undocumented.

## 9. What I could not verify
- Hytale player numbers, GSP terms and the per-licence server cap (support.hytale.com returned 403; the figures are snippets).
- FiveM's *current* enforcement against unauthorised hosts (the ban evidence is from 2018; today's partner list is snippets).
- Google Trends, Reddit sizes and "<game> server hosting" search volumes for every game.
- Farming Simulator 25, Bannerlord and SCUM hosting terms; FS25 Linux feasibility.
- Our real cost per GB per node (so margin is a proxy). Per-game support load outside Valheim.
- Whether competitors lack jar pinning, join kits, cross-region transfer or Discord bots (absence not proven).
- Fees and coverage of GCash/QRIS PSPs. Stripe SG's PayNow/GrabPay is a snippet.
- Whether `app/newwebsitev*` routes are publicly reachable. Free-MC signup counts and free-to-paid conversion (not in the snapshot).
- Minehut free-tier date changes (fetched page confirmed the plans; the dates are snippets because the support article returned 403).

## Product-led growth research is done

The main finding is that **activation is the bottleneck, not the catalogue**. In September, 604 people signed up but only 30 ever had a server (29 paid), about 5%. Paid invoices for September came to $705.21. None of the 51 customers came through a referral or partner link. So adding more games will do less than fixing the first deploy.

**Caveat: the traffic jump since 2026-09-25 may not be real people.** Visits went from about 50 to about 4,000 a day, almost all "(direct)", 97.5% desktop, and mostly from countries that are usually mobile-heavy (Bangladesh, India, Vietnam). It could be bots or a paid campaign, and it changes how to read the 5%.

Steam player counts below are from Valve's API, sampled once by me on 2026-10-01 17:35 UTC.

### Top 10 actions
1. **Fast first deploy:** carry the game from the landing page into the wizard pre-selected, default the region from geo, show the 72h money-back at the pay step, and email no-deploy signups at 1h and 24h (prd-001, prd-002, prd-030).
2. **Modpack step in the Minecraft deploy wizard:** offer the top server-side Modrinth packs (Cobblemon Official 11.0M downloads, COBBLEVERSE 6.9M, Better MC 3.5M, Prominence II 2.1M) and size the plan automatically. The .mrpack installer exists but the wizard has no modpack step (prd-010).
3. **Valheim 1.0 package:** BepInEx as default (2 of 4 live servers are vanilla, so mods can't load), presets, world import, the checkout password fix, and a warning before installing mods friends also need (prd-003, -013, -032). Valheim had 152,985 players on 2026-10-01 after 1.0 launched on 2026-09-09.
4. **Join-kit / share-a-server link:** address, password for invitees, the exact client mod list, console-join steps, and a referral-tracked "host your own" button. This is the viral loop and it removes the most common mod ticket (prd-012).
5. **SEA payment methods:** PayNow and GrabPay through Stripe now, then GCash and QRIS through a local payment provider (prd-021). Checkout is card, PayPal and crypto only today.
6. **Rust:** one-click Oxide/Carbon install, plus the open uMod manifest (1,419 plugins against 29 in our catalogue). Rust had 88,710 players (prd-006).
7. **Free Minecraft to paid:** a one-click upgrade that keeps the world, shown on honest triggers such as wake time over 30 seconds or a modpack that needs more RAM (prd-018).
8. **Hytale:** apply for Hypixel's game-server-provider registration now, and meanwhile launch with customers signing in with their own licence (prd-024).
9. **Launch windows:** Enshrouded 1.0 on 2026-10-15 and the ARK: Survival Ascended Dragontopia map on 2026-12-09 (prd-008, prd-009).
10. **Self-serve cancel/refund and honest provisioning failures.** Live chats show customers who couldn't find a cancel button and hit a 404 (prd-031).

### What to cut or demote
- **Retire Nightingale** for new orders (56 players).
- **Demote seven games under 1,000 players** from the main picker but keep them orderable: Sandstorm, Necesse, Empyrion, Sunkenland, Eco, Mordhau, Stationeers.
- **Do not sell managed FiveM.** Keep it VPS-only. Cfx.re banned unauthorised hosts in 2018 and now lists six authorised partners.
- **Keep Schedule I unorderable** and Plutonium unlisted.
- **Remove or noindex the draft routes `app/newwebsitev1` to `v8`.**
- **Measure /free-vps conversion** before investing more in it.
- **Lead the homepage and nav with game servers.**

### 5 riskiest assumptions
1. The traffic since 09-25 is real human demand.
2. The 5% is an activation problem, not low-intent signups (for example promo hunters).
3. A "Nxeon Verified" badge or modpack partner pages will move purchases. I found no evidence players value host-issued badges; competitors win modpack traffic through creator links.
4. Hytale will accept us as a provider, or paid hosting on customers' own licences is allowed. The EULA calls it a personal, non-commercial licence.
5. Lower renewal prices or regional pricing would add revenue rather than cut margin. There is no renewal or churn data yet, and our real cost per GB isn't documented.

### What I could not verify
- Hytale's provider terms, server cap and player numbers (support.hytale.com returned 403; figures are search snippets).
- Whether FiveM bans unauthorised hosts today (the ban evidence is from 2018).
- Google Trends, Reddit and search volume for every game.
- Farming Simulator 25 hosting terms and Linux feasibility. It is the strongest demand gap I found that earlier research didn't cover (40,390 players).
- Our real per-node cost, and support load for any game except Valheim.
- Whether competitors truly lack jar pinning, join kits or self-serve region transfer.
- Fees for GCash/QRIS payment providers.
- Whether the newwebsitev routes are publicly reachable.
- How many free Minecraft servers convert to paid.

Other pricing points:
- Our intro prices are competitive. Renewal is about 1.44x intro on every game.
- CS2 is overpriced at $17.26 for 2 GB; DatHost charges €13.86 a month for 14 slots.
- A quarterly 10% term would match Shockbyte and DatHost.

Files are in /root/growth:
- product-growth.md (cited report)
- product-growth.json (42 options including 3 removals; 35 recommended)

Supporting data is in the growth folder of the scratchpad:
- ccu-2026-10-01.csv (Steam player counts)
- ts-valheim.json (Thunderstore Valheim top mods)

1. **Fast first deploy:** carry the game from the landing page into the wizard pre-selected, default the region from geo, show the 72h money-back at the pay step, and email no-deploy signups at 1h and 24h (prd-001, prd-002, prd-030).
2. **Modpack step in the Minecraft deploy wizard:** offer the top server-side Modrinth packs (Cobblemon Official 11.0M downloads, COBBLEVERSE 6.9M, Better MC 3.5M, Prominence II 2.1M) and size the plan automatically. The .mrpack installer exists but the wizard has no modpack step (prd-010).
3. **Valheim 1.0 package:** BepInEx as default (2 of 4 live servers are vanilla, so mods can't load), presets, world import, the checkout password fix, and a warning before installing mods friends also need (prd-003, -013, -032). Valheim had 152,985 players on 2026-10-01 after 1.0 launched on 2026-09-09.
4. **Join-kit / share-a-server link:** address, password for invitees, the exact client mod list, console-join steps, and a referral-tracked "host your own" button. This is the viral loop and it removes the most common mod ticket (prd-012).
5. **SEA payment methods:** PayNow and GrabPay through Stripe now, then GCash and QRIS through a local payment provider (prd-021). Checkout is card, PayPal and crypto only today.
6. **Rust:** one-click Oxide/Carbon install, plus the open uMod manifest (1,419 plugins against 29 in our catalogue). Rust had 88,710 players (prd-006).
7. **Free Minecraft to paid:** a one-click upgrade that keeps the world, shown on honest triggers such as wake time over 30 seconds or a modpack that needs more RAM (prd-018).
8. **Hytale:** apply for Hypixel's game-server-provider registration now, and meanwhile launch with customers signing in with their own licence (prd-024).
9. **Launch windows:** Enshrouded 1.0 on 2026-10-15 and the ARK: Survival Ascended Dragontopia map on 2026-12-09 (prd-008, prd-009).
10. **Self-serve cancel/refund and honest provisioning failures.** Live chats show customers who couldn't find a cancel button and hit a 404 (prd-031).

### What to cut or demote
- **Retire Nightingale** for new orders (56 players).
- **Demote seven games under 1,000 players** from the main picker but keep them orderable: Sandstorm, Necesse, Empyrion, Sunkenland, Eco, Mordhau, Stationeers.
- **Do not sell managed FiveM.** Keep it VPS-only. Cfx.re banned unauthorised hosts in 2018 and now lists six authorised partners.
- **Keep Schedule I unorderable** and Plutonium unlisted.
- **Remove or noindex the draft routes `app/newwebsitev1` to `v8`.**
- **Measure /free-vps conversion** before investing more in it.
- **Lead the homepage and nav with game servers.**

### 5 riskiest assumptions
1. The traffic since 09-25 is real human demand.
2. The 5% is an activation problem, not low-intent signups (for example promo hunters).
3. A "Nxeon Verified" badge or modpack partner pages will move purchases. I found no evidence players value host-issued badges; competitors win modpack traffic through creator links.
4. Hytale will accept us as a provider, or paid hosting on customers' own licences is allowed. The EULA calls it a personal, non-commercial licence.
5. Lower renewal prices or regional pricing would add revenue rather than cut margin. There is no renewal or churn data yet, and our real cost per GB isn't documented.

### What I could not verify
- Hytale's provider terms, server cap and player numbers (support.hytale.com returned 403; figures are search snippets).
- Whether FiveM bans unauthorised hosts today (the ban evidence is from 2018).
- Google Trends, Reddit and search volume for every game.
- Farming Simulator 25 hosting terms and Linux feasibility. It is the strongest demand gap I found that earlier research didn't cover (40,390 players).
- Our real per-node cost, and support load for any game except Valheim.
- Whether competitors truly lack jar pinning, join kits or self-serve region transfer.
- Fees for GCash/QRIS payment providers.
- Whether the newwebsitev routes are publicly reachable.
- How many free Minecraft servers convert to paid.

Other pricing points:

I've finished the research. The cited report is at `/root/growth/product-growth.md` and the option list at `/root/growth/product-growth.json`, and I've sent the summary below to the agent that started this task.

The main finding is that the bottleneck is getting signups to deploy, not the game list. In September, 604 people signed up but only 30 ever had a server (29 paid), about 5%. Paid invoices came to $705.21, and none of the 51 customers came through a referral. Adding games won't fix that.

**Caveat on the numbers:** visits jumped from about 50 to about 4,000 a day from 2026-09-25. That traffic is almost all "direct", 97.5% desktop, and mostly from Bangladesh, India and Vietnam, where traffic is usually mobile-heavy. It may be bots or a paid campaign, so treat demand since then as unconfirmed.

**Top 10 actions** (Steam player counts are ones I sampled once on 2026-10-01):
1. **Faster first deploy:** pre-select the game from the landing page, default the region from location, show the existing 72-hour money-back at the pay step, and email people who sign up but don't deploy at 1 hour and 24 hours.
2. **Modpack choice in the Minecraft deploy wizard**, with the plan sized to the pack. Good starting picks are Cobblemon, Better MC and Prominence II, all on Modrinth, which we can already install. The installer exists; the wizard just doesn't offer it.
3. **A Valheim 1.0 package:** BepInEx mod loader on by default (2 of 4 live Valheim servers can't load mods today), preset mod sets, world import, the checkout password fix, and a warning before installing mods that friends also need. Valheim had 152,985 players after 1.0 launched on 2026-09-09.
4. **A shareable "join kit" link per server:** address, password for invited friends, the exact mod list they need, console join steps, and a referral-tracked "host your own" button. This is the viral loop, and it prevents the most common mod ticket.
5. **Local payment methods for Southeast Asia:** PayNow and GrabPay through Stripe now, then GCash and QRIS through a local provider. Today it's card, PayPal and crypto only.
6. **Rust:** install the Oxide/Carbon plugin framework in one click, and load the open uMod list (1,419 plugins against our 29).
7. **Free Minecraft to paid:** a one-click upgrade that keeps the world, offered on honest triggers like slow wake-ups or a modpack needing more RAM.
8. **Hytale:** apply now to Hypixel's programme for hosting providers, and meanwhile launch with customers signing in on their own licence.
9. **Launch pages and capacity checks** for Enshrouded 1.0 (2026-10-15) and ARK's Dragontopia map (2026-12-09).
10. **Self-serve cancel and refund, and honest messages when provisioning fails.** Live chats show customers who couldn't find a cancel button and hit a 404.

**What to cut:**
- Stop new sales of Nightingale (56 players).
- Move seven games with under 1,000 players out of the main picker, still orderable: Sandstorm, Necesse, Empyrion, Sunkenland, Eco, Mordhau, Stationeers.
- Don't sell managed FiveM: its owner has blocked unauthorised hosts before, so keep it as run-it-yourself on a VPS.
- Keep Schedule I unorderable and Plutonium unlisted.
- Remove or hide the eight draft site folders `newwebsitev1` to `v8` in the live app.
- Measure whether /free-vps converts before investing in it.
- Lead the homepage with game servers.

**Pricing:**
- Intro prices are competitive.
- Renewal is about 1.44 times the intro price on every game.
- CS2 is overpriced at $17.26 for 2 GB against DatHost's €13.86 a month for 14 slots.

**Riskiest assumptions:**
- The recent traffic is real people.
- The 5% means a deploy problem rather than low-intent signups.
- A "Nxeon Verified" badge would sell anything. I found no evidence players value badges from hosts.
- Hytale will let us host commercially; its licence is worded as personal and non-commercial.
- Lower renewal or regional prices would grow revenue rather than just cut margin, when no server has reached renewal yet.

**Not verified:**
- Hytale's hosting terms and player numbers (their support site blocked me).
- Whether FiveM still blocks unauthorised hosts (that evidence is from 2018).
- Search volumes for any game.
- Farming Simulator 25's hosting terms. It's the biggest demand gap I found at 40,390 players.
- Our real cost per GB, and support load for any game except Valheim.
- Fees for GCash/QRIS payment providers.
- Whether the draft site folders are publicly reachable.
- How many free Minecraft servers turn into paid ones.

The JSON has 42 options, 35 of them recommended, including three removals.
